notarySection.title: Certified Sworn Translation, Notarization & Equivalency (Denklik)
notarySection.subtitle: We provide comprehensive guidance and professional assistance for preparing your academic and legal files in full compliance with Turkish universities and government authorities.
notarySection.swornTranslationDesc: Official certified translation of academic transcripts, diplomas, and passports into Turkish by state-licensed sworn translators.
notarySection.notaryDesc: Facilitating notarization through accredited Turkish Notary Public offices to ensure full legal acceptance across universities and YÖK.
notarySection.denklikDesc: Guidance and file preparation for high school equivalency (MEB Denklik) and higher education recognition/equivalency (YÖK Tanıma & Denklik).
notarySection.disclaimerText: Our platform provides academic counseling and file preparation support. Official diploma equivalency certificates and notary approvals are issued exclusively by authorized Turkish government bodies (MEB, YÖK, and Turkish Notaries).

pricingNotice.title: Transparent Pricing & Service Policy - Al-Majd Admissions
pricingNotice.desc: Initial academic counseling and field-of-study selection are completely free. Official private university placement, document preparation, sworn translation, and residency follow-ups are subject to specified service fees and are not provided free of charge.
pricingNotice.paidServices: Admission Processing, Translation & Notary (Service Fee Applies)

aboutPage.heroTitle: Pioneering Educational Counseling and Academic Excellence in Turkey
aboutPage.heroDesc: Al-Majd Admissions was founded with a dedicated mission: to remove all barriers for international students seeking to study at premier Turkish public and private universities with the highest standards of transparency.
aboutPage.missionDesc: Providing honest, expert educational counseling tailored to global employment trends, securing direct admissions, and guiding students seamlessly through graduation.
aboutPage.visionDesc: To be the most trusted and preferred gateway in the MENA region and worldwide for studying in Turkey by fostering robust partnerships with leading Turkish universities.
aboutPage.valuesSubtitle: The foundational pillars underpinning every student service we offer
aboutPage.val1Desc: Verified facts, guaranteed scholarship percentages, and zero hidden costs.
aboutPage.val2Desc: Licensed academic counselors with over 8 years of specialized field experience.
aboutPage.val3Desc: Continuous personal support until you are comfortably settled on campus.
aboutPage.val4Desc: Strategic advising for future-ready careers and seamless post-graduation success.

uniDetailPage.docsBachelorTitle: 📄 Required Documents for Bachelor's & Associate Degrees:
uniDetailPage.docHighSchoolCert: Original High School Diploma with certified Turkish translation.
uniDetailPage.docTranscript: Official High School Transcripts for all completed academic years.
uniDetailPage.docPassport: Valid passport with at least 6 months remaining validity.
uniDetailPage.docPhotos: Recent biometric passport-sized photographs on white background.
uniDetailPage.docLanguageProficiency: Language proficiency certificate (TOEFL / TÖMER) if available, or take the university placement test.
uniDetailPage.docsGraduateTitle: 🎓 Additional Required Documents for Master's & PhD:
uniDetailPage.docBachelorDegree: Bachelor's Degree Certificate and detailed official transcript.
uniDetailPage.faqQ1: What is the primary medium of instruction at {{name}}?
uniDetailPage.faqA1: Degree programs are offered in Turkish or 100% English depending on your major. Intensive preparatory language programs are available for students needing language mastery prior to degree study.
uniDetailPage.faqQ2: Is {{name}} accredited internationally and by YÖK?
uniDetailPage.faqA2: Yes, the institution is officially accredited by the Turkish Higher Education Council (YÖK) and adheres to the European Bologna ECTS system, ensuring worldwide diploma recognition.
uniDetailPage.faqQ3: How does the application process work and what are the fees?
uniDetailPage.faqA3: Initial academic consultation and major selection are completely free. Official private university placement, sworn translations, and notary verification involve transparently stated service fees.
